final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.account_id AS acc, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS signed_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS bal_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), s2 AS (SELECT region, AVG(signed_avg) AS c2, AVG(bal_avg) AS c3 FROM s1 GROUP BY region), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS c1 FROM s2) SELECT s2.region, s2.c2, s2.c3, CASE WHEN s3.c1 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE s2.c2 * 1.0 / s3.c1 END AS ratio FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.c1 IS NOT NULL
